name: generateAgent
description: Generate a specialized Copilot agent from repository code analysis using AI models

inputSchema.title: GenerateAgent Input
inputSchema.description: Configuration for generating a new Copilot agent

repositoryUrl.title: Repository URL
repositoryUrl.description: GitHub repository URL (HTTPS clone URL) or local path to analyze

repositoryName.title: Repository Name
repositoryName.description: Human-readable name of the repository for context

codebaseContext.title: Codebase Context
codebaseContext.description: Brief description of what the codebase does, its purpose, and key features
examples: A workflow automation platform for generating specialized Copilot agents from code analysis

agentPurpose.title: Agent Purpose
agentPurpose.description: Primary purpose and specialization of the agent to generate

customPurpose.title: Custom Purpose
customPurpose.description: Custom purpose description if agentPurpose is 'custom'
examples: Agent that specializes in Kubernetes cluster management

agentStyle.title: Output Style
agentStyle.description: Style and detail level of generated AGENTS.md documentation

modelChoice.title: AI Model
modelChoice.description: LLM to use for code analysis and agent generation (via GitHub Models API)

recommendations.gpt-4o: Best quality, 50 calls/day, 2-3 min per analysis. Use for production agents.
recommendations.gpt-4o-mini: Fastest, 150 calls/day, 30-60 sec per analysis. Use for iterations.
recommendations.claude-3-5-sonnet: Best prompt following, 50 calls/day. Use for complex requirements.

extractGitHistory.title: Include Git History Analysis
extractGitHistory.description: Analyze git commit history to infer coding patterns and conventions

analyzeTests.title: Analyze Tests
analyzeTests.description: Examine test files to understand testing patterns and approaches

outputFormat.title: Output Format
outputFormat.description: Format for the generated agent definition

outputSchema.title: GenerateAgent Output
outputSchema.description: Generated agent definition and supporting artifacts

agentId.description: Unique identifier for the generated agent

agentName.description: User-friendly name of the generated agent

agentsMarkdown.description: Complete AGENTS.md content for the generated agent

toolDefinitions.description: Array of tool schemas the agent can use

integrationInstructions.description: Step-by-step instructions to integrate generated agent into your environment

parentAgent.description: Reference to the agent that generated this one (for tracking lineage)

modelUsed.description: AI model used to generate this agent

usageExamples.title: Generate Web Scraping Agent
usageExamples.description: Create an agent specialized in web scraping and analysis

input.codebaseContext: Python-based web scraper with Selenium and BeautifulSoup

usageExamples.expectedOutput: web_scraper_AGENTS.md with specialized web scraping capabilities

usageExamples.title: Generate Data Pipeline Agent
usageExamples.description: Create agent for data transformation and ETL operations

input.codebaseContext: Apache Airflow DAGs for data ETL and transformations

usageExamples.title: Recursive: Extend Existing Agent
usageExamples.description: Use an existing agent to generate an enhanced version of itself

input.codebaseContext: Previous agent focused on REST APIs. Now add GraphQL support.
input.customPurpose: Enhanced REST + GraphQL API testing agent

usageExamples.expectedOutput: Enhanced agent with both REST and GraphQL capabilities

notes.recursion: This tool is designed for recursive use. Generated agents inherit this tool, enabling agents to generate other agents.
notes.costEstimation: Uses GitHub Models (free with GitHub Pro). Costs: 0 for any of the models with Pro account.
notes.timeEstimation: 2-5 minutes per repository depending on size and model choice.
notes.dataHandling: Clones repository temporarily, analyzes locally, no persistent storage of source code.
